title: Duriankari language - Wikipedia
text: Duriankari (or Duriankere) is a possibly extinct Papuan language (or dialect) of Indonesian Papua. It is associated with the Duriankari people of the eponymous village [id] situated at the southern tip of the island of Salawati, which is part of the Raja Ampat Archipelago and is adjacent to the Bird's Head Peninsula of the West Papuan mainland.
